topic: Your brain's best guess 5: Your compliment lands better than you expect
caption:
Your compliment lands better than you expect.

The prediction: saying that compliment out loud would be awkward.

In experiments, people giving compliments underestimated how good the receiver felt, and overestimated the awkwardness. Givers worry about getting the wording right. Receivers notice the warmth.

Something to try: you could tell someone one kind thing you have only thought.

Your brain's best guess is our series on everyday predictions that research suggests are often too pessimistic. Studies were with US participants and measured immediate reactions, so results may differ for you.

Research: Zhao, X., & Epley, N. (2021). Insufficiently complimentary?: Underestimating the positive impact of compliments creates a barrier to expressing them. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 121(2), 239-256. https://doi.org/10.1037/pspa0000277
